Mission Local reported that a 16-year-old boy spent almost three weeks in San Francisco County Jail after allegedly giving law enforcement a false name and birthday. The city took 20 days to verify that he was a minor, and he was kept apart from other inmates in a section for people with special needs. The story also noted that California law bars people under 18 from being held in adult jails.
